opening.text: I have stomach pain that started two weeks ago. It's a burning sensation, and when I have the pain, it's a 7 out of 10, and then it can go down to 0. Sometimes I feel nauseated when I'm in pain, and I vomited. I take ibuprofen for the arthritis in my knees, and I take Maalox. My father died at 55 of pancreatic cancer.
